premises.text: Unethical fake-free, crippleware, and spyware freemium offers erode mainstream trust so users miss great free apps
premises.evidence_span: unethical businesses are eroding our trust in the concept of free

premises.text: CatchFree organizes user sentiment and structured data so people can quickly verify whether a free product is safe and find top picks by job-to-be-done
premises.evidence_span: a fast and easy verification whether a free product is safe

premises.text: Heart-logo top user picks signal commitment to proposed freemium principles alongside category exploration and UGC feature voting
premises.evidence_span: anytime you see this CatchFree heart logo, it means that this product is a top user pick in its category

premises.text: CatchFree monetizes via profitable CPAs and reverse-affiliate credits limited to top user picks, keeping users in control
premises.evidence_span: CatchFree is actually going to offer profitable CPAs to freemium businesses

value.text: Mainstream users can safely and easily find the best free products and avoid hidden catches
value.evidence_span: safer and easier for people to find the best free products and avoid those with hidden catches

causal_links.evidence_span: it's just not worth the risk of trying a free product
find the best free app or service that does exactly what you want it to do
users are in control with CatchFree
